name: Motorcycle Simulator California
summary:
Ride Los Angeles, California, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

48 KM ROUND LOS ANGELES
The Santa Monica Freeway east past La Cienega, La Brea and Crenshaw into the downtown skyline. The Harbor Freeway south past USC and the LA Memorial Coliseum, the Century Freeway west past SoFi Stadium, then the 405 north past LAX and Culver City.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
